method: GitHub REST API issue bodies plus all accessible paginated issue-conversation comments. Stored raw records are ignored workspace inputs, not executable code. Hashes identify retrieved records, not proof of upstream correctness. Scope review focuses on the motivating body and relevant discussion, not external linked pages.

reports.title: clang does not properly optimize xor expressions
reports.scope: Deferred: the motivating cancellation crosses zext, shifts and two widths; opaque leaves intentionally do not move casts through shifts.

reports.title: Combine and-mask+icmp eq -> icmp ule when mask was all-ones in high bits
reports.scope: Deferred: OR-mask equality versus its source needs a range/comparison fold; per-bit synthesis does not reinterpret an integer comparison as bitwise logic.

reports.title: redundant mask op could be eliminated
reports.scope: Deferred: reuse of a masked value across stores and truncation needs dominance-aware cross-width CSE, not producer-network synthesis.

reports.title: Missing opt with ctlz and shifts of power of 2 constants
reports.scope: Deferred: total CLZ after shifting a constant saturates at the width. The discussion distinguishes nonzero, exact and no-wrap variants; no flag is invented.

reports.title: [InstCombine] and-mask + conditional "sext" -> and-mask + sext
reports.scope: Deferred: variable-width conditional sign extension needs bounds on len and a separate sign-extension recognizer; signed C shifts also need defined witnesses.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Dropping pointless masking before right shift
reports.scope: Deferred: removing a dynamic mask before arithmetic/right shift requires demanded-bit reasoning tied to the same count; shifts remain opaque here.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Dropping pointless masking before left shift
reports.scope: Deferred: the six upstream mask/shift forms include truncation and count-sum constraints; no blanket mask removal is admitted.

reports.title: InstCombine combines mul->shift into two multiplies.
reports.scope: Deferred: multiply/rotate ordering is a pipeline and target-cost issue, not a bitwise-network identity; retain existing rotate recognition.

reports.title: Missed peephole: xor-inc-add to xor-sub
reports.scope: Implemented limited: private same-width (x xor C)+1 combined with wrapping add/sub is replaced by the complemented-constant xor and opposite add/sub.

reports.title: Failure to optimize compare and bitwise and with same operands properly (stuck at intermediate transformation)
reports.scope: Deferred: narrowing a Boolean observation to bit zero and CFG range-set folding need distinct observation/control-flow proofs.

reports.title: Failure to optimize xor pattern to xor
reports.scope: Implemented limited: the closed bitwise DAG ((a&b)^b)|((a&b)^a) synthesizes XOR, accounting for the internally shared AND once. Outside users refuse.

reports.title: Failure to optimize some related bool comparisons to xor+and
reports.scope: Deferred: the motivating short-circuit expression needs CFG/Boolean conversion reasoning; its bitwise analogue is not claimed as closure of the report.

reports.title: Failure to optimize simple bitwise pattern
reports.scope: Deferred: signed max, subtraction and a mask require signed range/select reasoning, including negative inputs; not a pure Boolean identity.

reports.title: Optimize switch wirh icmp with and
reports.scope: Deferred: common-destination switch and bitfield-mask simplification require switch-domain reasoning rather than a local bitwise root.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for icmp ult <power-of-2> & mask check
reports.scope: Deferred: combining a power-of-two unsigned bound with a contiguous mask comparison needs range-interval proofs; sparse masks cannot be generalized.

reports.title: failed to fold shift amount offset into shift of a constant, part 2
reports.scope: Deferred: shifting a negative constant by an offset depends on exact-shift and count bounds. Those LLVM promises are absent from LCCC IR.

reports.title: Missed optimization: Bitwise shifts don't backpropagate knowledge about their operands
reports.scope: Deferred: never infer a global range backward from a C shift. The discussion warns that shifts can be speculated and yield LLVM poison.

reports.title: Failure to optimise shift+and+boolean conversion pattern to simple comparison
reports.scope: Implemented limited: comparisons of a masked shifted power of two to zero reduce to count equality/inequality when an explicit scalar AND proves the count is in range. Bounded value-preserving count casts/copies retain the actual count operand/type.

reports.title: Missing optimization for shift+and+boolean pattern
reports.scope: Implemented limited: a left-shifted power of two observed through a low contiguous mask reduces to a count threshold under that explicit bound. Bounded value-preserving count casts/copies retain the actual count operand/type.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Failure to recognise hidden xor
reports.scope: Deferred: AND of two constant-choice selects observed as zero needs relational reasoning across selects; selects and comparisons stay opaque.

reports.title: Missed optimisation opportunity for `xor` lowering
reports.scope: Implemented limited: the eager scalar bitwise XOR networks in the discussion are synthesized exactly. Short-circuit CFG restructuring is not included.

reports.title: Weaken `xor` to `or` under `nand`
reports.scope: Deferred: weakening XOR to OR is not an unconditional Boolean identity; it requires a dominating NAND assumption and relational facts.

reports.title: Nan boxing misoptimization: missing icmp combine?
reports.scope: Deferred: NaN-tag range coalescing is integer interval reasoning across two comparisons, not FP arithmetic or a pure bitwise replacement.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing fold for 'and' pattern with multiple used 'xor'
reports.scope: Deferred: multiply-used sext/not to select depends on Boolean provenance and sharing costs. No cast or select is synthesized here.

reports.title: [DAG] SimplifySetCC - failure to simplify icmp(not(x),not(y)) -> icmp(y, x) patterns
reports.scope: Implemented limited: comparisons of two private same-width bitwise NOT values reverse operand order, preserving the original signed/unsigned predicate.

reports.title: Transform 31 - CTLZ into CTLZ ^ 31 on x86
reports.scope: Deferred: the proposed total CLZ rewrite is invalid at zero, as the discussion corrects. A nonzero precondition must be proved separately.

reports.title: Inconsistent behaviour between using logical and bitwise `and`/`or` on `smin`/`smax`
reports.scope: Deferred: signed min/max sign observations and logical versus bitwise forms require select/CFG correlation. The source also repeats the smin body as smax.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missing and of icmp fold
reports.scope: Deferred: folding the guarded x+1 bound needs relational carry/unsigned interval reasoning; no no-wrap condition is inferred from a Boolean graph.

reports.title: Consider reducing 64-bit shifts with clamped shift amounts to 32-bit
reports.scope: Deferred: 64-to-32 shift splitting depends on target shift costs, count ranges and legalization; three-leaf scalar logic does not narrow shifts.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed optimization for icmp(constants[x]) when the range of x is implied
reports.scope: Deferred: proving a constant-table load range needs memory/constant-global analysis with a dominating index bound.

reports.title: Comparison of add of extended booleans not folded to xor
reports.scope: Deferred: equal-to-one observations of added Boolean extensions require arithmetic Boolean-cardinality reasoning; new bitwise synthesis treats extensions as opaque.

reports.title: [InstructionSimplify] The result of icmp should be false.
reports.scope: Deferred: comparing an OR against a logical shift needs cross-operation unsigned bounds. The issue discussion also corrects an initially over-reduced example.

reports.title: folds for icmp-of-sum-of-extended-i1 aren't happening in more complex code
reports.scope: Deferred: tuple ordering combines sext/zext arithmetic, comparisons and selects; the canonical Boolean comparison must be recovered before any bitwise synthesis.

reports.title: [instcombine] fold icmp eq/ne (min a, b), (max a, b) to icmp eq/ne a, b
reports.scope: Deferred: equality of min/max or symmetric selects needs correlated select predicates, widths and signedness. This change does not assume independent selects are min/max.

reports.title: [SCCP][ConstantRange] Missed optimization due to approximation of `xor` operation on ConstantRange
reports.scope: Deferred: precise XOR constant ranges after CLZ need interval analysis beyond the existing known-bit representation.

reports.title: popcount 8-bit optimization opportunity (without HW instructions)
reports.scope: Deferred: narrow software popcount multiplication/mask formulas need per-target size/latency assessment against native POPCNT and the existing fallback.

reports.title: bit-count operation fallbacks can be optimized based on mask
reports.scope: Deferred: sparse-mask count lowering requires target-specific popcount/ctz cost and zero-policy handling; no hardware intrinsic is expanded into multiplication here.

reports.title: target emission for ctlz doesn't account for range metadata
reports.scope: Deferred: nonzero narrow CLZ promotion belongs in target legalization; target-independent logic does not add shifts/casts around scans.

reports.title: Missed Optimization (InstCombine): Convert constant mask M: (x&~M)|((x&M)&~(y&M)) to x&~(y&M)
reports.scope: Implemented limited: closed mask-extract/update/reinsert DAGs synthesize shorter AND/OR/XOR forms, including complementary literal masks. Arbitrary externally shared graphs refuse.

reports.title: LLVM fails to optimize emulated arithmetic right shift down to a single ashr
reports.scope: Deferred: sign-conditioned logical shifts emulate AShr, but recovering that requires select, signed comparison and shared-count proofs.

reports.title: LLVM fails to optimize BitScanForward loop to a single cttz instruction
reports.scope: Deferred: replacing a scan loop by total CTZ needs loop-exit/PHI/zero-case reasoning; no loop or memory transformations are added.

reports.title: Multiply by a power of 2 and ctz+shift should often be interchangeable
reports.scope: Deferred: low-bit multiply versus CTZ/shift is target-cost sensitive and needs an explicit zero policy. Do not introduce a scan on software-scan targets.

reports.title: [ValueTracking] Missed optimization: Infer known bits from `a & mask == 0`
reports.scope: Deferred: the example needs a relational nonzero-mask fact across a branch/call. No new closure is claimed for the preexisting facts pass.

reports.title: Missed optimization: right shift (>>) with first operand up-cast to longer types
reports.scope: Deferred: cross-width right shifts and casts need a count-range proof for both widths plus sign-extension preservation.

reports.title: Missed peephole opt: `sub nuw 15, x` => `xor x, 15`
reports.scope: Deferred: 15-x to xor needs x<=15 or LLVM nuw. Generic wrapping subtraction is not the same identity; target instruction-selection costs also matter.

reports.title: Bad codegen using `@llvm.ctlz.i8/i16`
reports.scope: Deferred: total narrow leading-ones promotion and BSR/LZCNT speculation differ by target and zero policy; preserve the current count lowering.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Optimize multiple compares using `xor`
reports.scope: Deferred: Unicode range coalescing through XOR/subtract is not uniformly profitable (discussion identifies AArch64 conditional compare); requires a range cost model.

reports.title: Failure to optimize shift+compare pattern for sign check when done as a ternary as well as when using a computed goto
reports.scope: Deferred: simplifying the ternary sign observation needs substituting condition facts into select arms, not eager bitwise evaluation of a control-flow graph.

reports.title: `-1 << (k + 1)` => `-2 << k` Inverted shift optimizations should incorporate offsets
reports.scope: Deferred: shift-offset folding must prove the adjusted count cannot wrap or reach the word width; do not assume Zig intCast/LLVM nuw facts exist in LCCC.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Missed combines for `(icmp (udiv exact x1, y) (udiv exact x2, y))`
reports.scope: Deferred: dropping paired divisions from comparisons requires exactness/divisibility, not just a common divisor. LCCC does not represent the reported exact flag.
